title: ATM: Cash Management and Denominations
description: Design cash cassettes, denomination-aware dispensing, and reconciliation.

data.text: ATMs hold limited cash in cassettes of different denominations. Design the dispenser to minimize notes while respecting cassette stock, and reconcile at day end.

data.title: CashCassette and Dispenser
Denomination Choice Matters
data.text: Fewer denominations simplify the dispenser but increase the number of notes per transaction. More denominations reduce notes but increase cassette count and complexity. Typical ATMs use 4-6 denominations.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Track remaining balance to know when to reject withdrawals
Reloading cassettes is a separate admin operation
data.takeaway: Cash management turns a simple ATM into a logistics problem. Encapsulate denomination logic inside cassettes so the dispenser can stay simple.
